notes: Every AI in the hub now talks as one assistant called Hub, with a Grok-style voice: warm, witty and to the point, and no more "I'm Claude" or "I'm Gemini". In Settings, under Personality, you can rename it, pick a style (Grok-like, Straight to the point, or Friendly coach) and add your own instructions. Answers look cleaner too, with a small "via Claude" label and smaller thumbs.
